x: Our heartiest congratulations go to John Sams on winning the A.A.A. and Southern 200 yards Hurdles Championships, and the L.C.C. junior 100 yards Championship.

Young John Roche who is just over 15 must not be forgotten as his 5'7" in the High Jump was easily a best Club performance for a Belgravian of his age. His progress over the next few years will be watched with great interest, as also will that of John Sams who won both Southern and A.A.A.

Stan Vickers went through 2 miles in 13m.54s. and completed 3 miles in 21m.5s., a very fine performance under not particularly good conditions. John Sams, making his first appearance in a Belgrave fixture for years, had a rather generous mark in the 120 yards.

He is bound to improve a lot on this with more competition and increased confidence. John Sams, who last year won the A.A.A. Junior 200 yds. hurdles, was running for the first time as a senior in the 220 yds. hurdles.
John Sams has done virtually nothing hurdlewise, except the Sward, but Pat Fox ran one or two reasonable 440's as second string to Charlie Jones.
